title: Remove editor modelines and .editorconfig exceptions from root files
description:
One small step towards realizing #17253. Removes editor modelines from files in the tree root, and removes exceptions for those same files in the `.editorconfig` file.

Files were reformatted using vim's `=` operator, then a quick inspection. Some function definitions were lightly edited to make each file uniform in its format of same, but apart from that, there are no functional changes here, just whitespace changes.
